rows.title_full:
AN ACT DECLARING THE MARITIME ZONES UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF
THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish the legal bases by which social, economic, commercial, and other activities may be conducted thereat.
Delineates the territorial sea, contagious zone, exclusive economic zone, continental shelf, and extended continental shelf which will clear the exclusive rights and sovereign rights, as well as obligations, in each maritime zones.
Provides for the necessary flexibility in the passage of subsequent laws pertinent to the rights and obligations to which Philippines is entitled and may exercise over its maritime zones.
rows.status: Republic Act RA12064 enacted on 2024-11-07

rows.abstract:
Seeks to encourage lending institutions to adopt a corporate environmental policy to support environmental protection and sustainable development and to mitigate credit risks arising from the adverse impact of loans and other projects for financing in the environment.
Proposes several provisions, among others, regarding the following:  
a) compliance with the Environmental Impact Statement System under P.D. No. 1586 of any loan or related funding applications. . .;  b) conformity with environment laws of projects which is the subject of financing applications and collateral offered as security (the basis for approval of loan accounts with environmental impact); c) periodic monitoring reports of DENR of projects/collateral; d) integration of environment assessment report into the project proposal and or loan application.

rows.author: K077;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 29 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11861 ALSO KNOWN AS THE EXPANDED SOLO PARENTS WELFARE ACT
rows.abstract:
Amends Sec. 10 of R.A. No. 8972 as amended by Sec. __  of R.A. No. 11861 to be read as follows:
Sec.10. Child Minding Centers.  The DOLE and the CSC shall promote and encourage the establishment of appropriate child minding centers within the workplace, or in accessible locations to the workplace or residence of the solo parent.  PROVIDED THAT NGAs WITH MORE THAN 300 EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING GOCCs, AND PRIVATE EMPLOYERS WITH 200 OR MORE EMPLOYEES, ARE REQUIRED TO ESTABLISH CHILD MINDING CENTERS TO ACCOMMODATE THEIR EMPLOYEES´ CHILDREN WHO ARE AGED 7 YEARS AND BELOW . . .
Other related terms: day care centers
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2023-05-08

rows.author: K077;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8187 ALSO KNOWN AS THE PATERNITY LEAVE ACT OF 1996
rows.abstract:
States that every MALE employee in the private and public sectors shall be entitled to a paternity leave of FOURTEEN (14) days with full pay.  The male employee . . . shall notify his employer of the pregnancy of THE MOTHER OF HIS CHILD . . .
PROVIDED, FURTHERMORE, THAT THIS BENEFIT IS OVER AND ABOVE THAT WHICH IS PROVIDED UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11210, OR THE “104-DAY EXPANDED MATERNITY LEAVE LAW” . . .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2023-05-08
